summary: A fourth bell rings beneath Faelspire. An impossible black fragment addresses the reader-character and forces a choice among P'taxx, Aard Templu Voreath, and a scarred stray who has heard the bell before.

active_frontiers.title: The Filing
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: M1 canonical head. The Antiquarian route's route-true passage through the reconvergence. The shared lattice reveal (fourth point over the palace, the hand-shadow, 'It measures looking away / it has no word for looking back') is kept singular in 022 and the body FORKS here onto what the route actually carried in: P'taxx alone, no acolytes, no reliquary, the fragment filed behind the high door in 011, the copies standing in the semicircle ('every one of them has your face'), and the YOU LOOKED AWAY door title. The lattice's fourth point on THIS route is the filed proof the Antiquarian route actually carried — the high door's ring is the fourth point's voice. The scene ends by forking to 040e (the Crossing Question), which is re-grounded onto 011's carried state. The seam repair: the Antiquarian reader now arrives to route-true state, not a Temple-shaped room.

active_frontiers.title: The Temple
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: M1 canonical head. The Temple route's route-true passage through the reconvergence. The shared lattice reveal is kept singular in 022 and the body FORKS here onto what the Temple route actually carried in: the acolytes (the young one, the one who prays, the one with the short ceremonial blade), and the open iron reliquary bearing the protagonist's name. The lattice's fourth point on THIS route is the name-bearing reliquary — the name across the iron lid is the fourth point's voice. The 'that is impossible' beat and the P'taxx/acolyte confrontation are preserved verbatim from the Temple route's actual state (020/021a/021b). The scene ends by forking to 040b (the Second Question), unchanged.

active_frontiers.title: The Witness You Made
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: M3 performed fork. The apex body no longer pre-narrates the decision. The pre-declared act ('You choose it now. You turn your face from the copies...') is DELETED, and the two options are now two genuinely distinct actions under pressure, each landing on a changed state: Option 1 'Commit to the seam' (040a-make-the-witness-work.md) physically commits the protagonist to the seam — they turn their face to the opened seam, put the copy in the middle of the aim, hold it there, and stand the copy as the ledger's witness against itself, paying the WANT in its exact currency (they become the subject of the reading they did not choose to be in); Option 2 'Refuse the reading' (040a-03-the-act-not-narrated.md, NEW) physically holds the record unfinished — the protagonist does NOT cross to the copy, does NOT put their shoulder against its shoulder, does NOT let their eyes fall into the method's angle; they stand where they are and let the seam look at them and not find what it is looking for, losing the lever. The player's selection CARRIES the decision (performed agency), not merely picks an attitude toward an already-performed act. The N1 head's reclassification beat (the witness → subject filing in the make-leaf) is PRESERVED. The two leaves' opposed readings are preserved: make-leaf pays the WANT in its exact currency; refuse-leaf keeps the WANT unbroken. The refuse leaf now lands on the new 040a-03 (the performed-refuse landing), which carries the reader into the existing let-leaf chain (040a-let-the-record-stand → 040a-let-the-record-stand-01).

active_frontiers.title: Make the Witness Work
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The protagonist committed to the seam: they turned their face to the opened seam, put the copy in the middle of the aim, and let the seam file the look-away under the copy's name. In doing so they paid the WANT in its exact currency — they became the subject of the reading they did not choose to be in. The lever is real, the copy works for the ledger, and the protagonist's record — the one that was never finished — is now being finished under their own name. The exit is still closed. The N1 reclassification beat (the witness → subject filing) is preserved. The next scene must address what it means to be the one the ledger is finishing, and whether a subject can still make a move the method does not expect.

active_frontiers.title: The Act Not Narrated
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: M3 NEW refuse-action landing. The protagonist refused the reading by physically NOT crossing to the copy, NOT putting their shoulder against its shoulder, and NOT letting their eyes fall into the method's angle. The act is the player's chosen act — not the act the voice described, not the act the room expected. The copy stays a witness (not a subject the ledger can work on), the record about the protagonist stays unfinished, and the WANT holds. The cost is the lever: a witness the protagonist cannot deploy is a lever they no longer have. The scene is structurally distinct from 040a-make-the-witness-work (it carries the held-place act, not the commit-to-seam act) and from 040a-let-the-record-stand (it carries the performed act; the let-leaf carries the landed consequence). It ends by linking to 040a-let-the-record-stand (the existing let-leaf chain), which now holds the landed record-stands state and carries the reader into 040a-let-the-record-stand-01 (the recall).

active_frontiers.title: The Ledger's Recall
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: M1 re-grounded. The protagonist refused the reading, and the ledger, denied its flinch, did something it had not done before: it recalled the filed frame. The recall is costly — the high door's ring broke in the middle of its note, the line beneath **FILED** was carved, and the ledger spent its ring to pull the filed frame back into the protagonist's sight. The reclassification (filed → subject) is the consequence of the recall, not a pre-programmed gear. The copy's eyes changed: it is no longer a witness; it is a subject. The protagonist's act of holding their gaze *caused* the recall. The record about the protagonist is unfinished, the lever is spent, and the next scene must address what it means to be unmeasured at the cost of the ledger's recall — and whether the ledger, having spent its ring, will find another way to finish the one record it has not finished. (M2 branch: this frontier may be converted to a completed ending in a future cycle.)

active_frontiers.title: The Second Question
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The fragment demonstrated its method through the lattice: interrupt, provoke a look-away, preserve it, repeat. The protagonist broke the repetition, but the reliquary now bears their name and the system has widened its test to Faelspire. (Unaffected by M1/M3; reached from 022b.)

active_frontiers.title: The Second Question
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The kit replayed the protagonist's first involuntary look-away and the fragment tried to produce a second. The protagonist held their gaze, but the cistern identified them and its lid can no longer close. (Unaffected by M1/M3.)

active_frontiers.title: The Second Question
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The living fragment contains a completed record of the movement it provoked; the stray's sliver died when he stopped completing its tests. The protagonist interrupted the second record, but their name is legible and Faelspire has gone silent. (Unaffected by M1/M3.)

canonical_head.mutation: M1 — The Lattice Reads the Room (route-true reconvergence split) + M3 — The Gaze-Fork Is a Genuine Fork (apex agency repair)
canonical_head.title: The Lattice's body now branches on carried route state: 022-the-lattice (singular shared reveal) FORKS to 022a-the-lattice-filing (Antiquarian, NEW) and 022b-the-lattice-temple (Temple, NEW); the apex 040a is rewritten as a performed fork with a new refuse landing 040a-03 (NEW)
canonical_head.structure: M1 (canonical head): 022-the-lattice is split into a route-aware reconvergence. The shared lattice reveal (the window, the lattice, the fourth point over the palace, the hand-shaped shadow, the crack) is kept as a SINGULAR body in 022 — authored once, route-neutral, NOT duplicated. The acolytes, the open iron reliquary, and the 'that is impossible' whisper are moved OUT of the shared body. The 022 body then FORKS by carried route state into two NEW scenes: 022a-the-lattice-filing (Antiquarian route-true: P'taxx alone, no acolytes, no reliquary, the filed frame, the copies, the YOU LOOKED AWAY door title; the lattice's fourth point is the filed proof the route actually carried) and 022b-the-lattice-temple (Temple route-true: acolytes + open iron reliquary bearing the protagonist's name; the lattice's fourth point is the name-bearing reliquary). 040e is re-grounded onto 011's carried state (the Antiquarian route): the opening precondition is now satisfiable on the changed (022a) path, and the protected beats (the copy at the seam, the crossing question, the stand-the-copy choice) are preserved. 040a-let-the-record-stand and 040a-let-the-record-stand-01 are re-grounded onto 011's carried state (state repair) without changing the let-leaf's protected beats (the refuse-the-reading landing, the ledger's recall, the ring-break, the reclassification). The two leaves' outcomes are UNCHANGED: the make-leaf still pays the WANT in its exact currency, the let-leaf still keeps the WANT unbroken. M3 (co-accepted): 040a-the-witness-you-made is rewritten so the apex fork is PERFORMED not staged. The pre-narrated act ('You choose it now. You turn your face from the copies...') is DELETED. The two options are now two genuinely distinct actions under pressure: 'Commit to the seam' (physically commits to the seam, deploys the witness, pays the WANT) and 'Refuse the reading' (physically holds the record unfinished, refuses the reading, loses the lever). The lead-ins are corrected to read as dramatic actions, not descriptions of a completed act. A NEW reachable scene 040a-03-the-act-not-narrated is created as the refuse-action landing under the performed fork. It is reachable by a choice link from the apex and ends in a choice link into the existing let-leaf chain. The N1 head's reclassification beat is PRESERVED (M3 does not revert it). The reader-facing fiction advances by BOTH making the reconvergence route-true (M1) and making the apex performed (M3), restoring the story's two strongest interactive arguments (state as storytelling + performed agency) in one coherent, replay-testable pass.
canonical_head.note: M1 is the canonical head for this cycle (Acumen Keeper autonomous selection: M1 is the load-bearing foundation — the only mutation that repairs the rank-1 seam-leak at its root, the first real engagement of candidate law_4d3da1051141 (branch-aware reconvergence) at the 022 scale, and the causal repair on which M2/M3/M4 all depend). M3 is co-accepted (apex agency repair): it is the other half of the repair (M1 makes the reconvergence route-true, M3 makes the apex performed), it is small (one body rewrite + one new scene + two lead-in corrections), low-risk, and the first real engagement of candidate law_bb750d1bdb10 (apex-head decisive turn) at the 040a-witness apex. New reachable scenes: 022a, 022b (M1), 040a-03 (M3). M2 (completed-ending) and M4 (price-of-success divergence) are PRESERVED as active reader-facing branches — they are genuinely different structural futures that the Judge ordered to land after M1's seam is structurally sound and replay-tested. The 040b/040c/040d frontiers are unaffected by M1/M3. The orphaned scene 040a-the-second-question.md remains orphaned (no change). The two candidate laws (law_4d3da1051141, law_bb750d1bdb10) are reinforced (3rd observation / 2nd autonomous engagement respectively) but remain candidates pending a second independent Patrick decision.

active_branches.title: The Recall Becomes a Completed Decisive Act
active_branches.axis: terminal-act closure on the refuse leaf
active_branches.mechanism: The refuse leaf's terminal (040a-let-the-record-stand-01-the-ledgers-recall, which currently ends in an ACTIVE FRONTIER note) is converted into a COMPLETED decisive action: the recall is no longer an open scaffold but a closed turn with a priced, irreversible new state. A NEW scene (040a-02-the-record-that-was-never-finished) is created, reachable by a choice link that REPLACES the current FRONTIER block, and it carries the unresolved pressure forward as a landed consequence: the ledger has spent its only ring (an irreversible cost it can never repeat), the recalled frame is now a working subject the ledger can work on, and the protagonist is the one record it has not finished — a completed, measurable state rather than a question.
active_branches.coherence: PRESERVED as an active reader-facing branch — not implemented this cycle. The recall beat must stay verbatim in spirit ('It does not file. It does not provoke. It does not wait. It *recalls*'; 'the break is the cost'). The new scene's state must be irreversible and priced — no retreat to 'will you flinch' (candidate law_bb750d1bdb10). The two leaves' opposed readings (refuse = refusal-as-cost vs. make = surrender-as-lever) must remain opposed, not flattened. MUST land after M1 is implemented and replay-tested so the completed ending inherits grounded antecedents.
active_branches.status: PRESERVED as an active reader-facing branch (next-cycle candidate)

active_branches.title: The Gaze-Test Damages a Specific Want Differently Per Route
active_branches.mechanism: The protagonist is currently written as a pure refusal-instrument, so every held-gaze test costs the same currency (the WANT). This mutation gives the protagonist ONE specific want/history (established in 000/010, route-true) that the gaze-test damages DIFFERENTLY on each route: on the Antiquarian route the held gaze costs the relationship with P'taxx, on the Temple route it costs the acolytes' trust. A NEW scene (040f-the-cost-of-holding) is created, reachable by a choice link from the 040a terminal chain, that lands the route-specific cost as a priced, irreversible state.
active_branches.coherence: PRESERVED as an active reader-facing branch — not implemented this cycle. The want must be ONE concrete thing, not a subplot. The want must be established through action under pressure (law_4b28d7570c43), not an expository 'the protagonist wants X' paragraph. The route-specific cost routing depends on M1's branch-aware split (022a/022b), so MUST land after M1 is implemented and replay-tested. The protected beats (filed-frame, recall, two leaves' opposed readings) are preserved; the cost axis is additive, not replacement.
active_branches.status: PRESERVED as an active reader-facing branch (later-cycle candidate)
